text:
kevin: Heads up — prepping APAC demo tomorrow. Quick capacity + IAM sanity check: do we have 8x A100 slots in ap-northeast1 for 1h starting 2026-03-22 09:00 JST? Need to lock or borrow.

maria: @kevin I can check vendor pool. Which billing project? Also do we need preemptible or dedicated?

kevin: project: redwood-demo-prod. Dedicated preferred (low preemption). If not, preemptible ok but risk yanking during canary.

ash: Notebook shows current quota 6 GPUs in ap-northeast1 for that project. cc @infra-bot for live inventory.

infra-bot: Inventory summary: vendor-pool-apac-a100: 12 available; dedicated-reservations: 4 allocated; tenant-borrowable: 3. Estimated available for borrow: 3 (subject to pending invoices). Link: https://internal.redwood/vendcap/1234

maria: Looks like invoices for two racks are in 'pending payment' — vendor won't release until cleared. Finance pings?

ryan: Finance confirmed they can overnight the payment but need PO #RED-2026-187. Maria pls give vendor contact.

maria: I've DM'd vendor contact (Satoshi) and sent PO. Waiting ack.

kevin: If vendor can't release, can we swap region to ap-southeast1? Latency ok for demo.

ash: ap-southeast1 has quota 10 GPUs but only 2 dedicated. We can spin ephemeral nodes but may hit preemption.

kevin: Action: maria to confirm vendor ack by EOD PST. If not, I'll change demo target to ap-southeast1 and update docs. Also need IAM check — demo runners need compute.instances.* on that project for the window.

sasha: @kevin I updated the demo service account perms two days ago but only for us-east1. Patching now.

sasha: Patch done — test deploy works in ap-southeast1. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Thanks. One more ask: someone run quick `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-demo-prod` and paste GPU quota lines?

ash: Quick paste:
```:
GPU quotas:
  A100: 6/8 (region: ap-northeast1)
  A100: 2/10 (region: ap-southeast1)
```

maria: Vendor acked release, will confirm ETA 30m. If they cutover, we can borrow 4 dedicated for the hour.

kevin: :thumbsup: ok will stand by. I'll update the runbook and DM the demo owner.
